notes:
Windows installer; unblock files extracted from a downloaded zip

Files extracted from a downloaded zip keep Windows' "from the internet" mark,
and .NET refuses to load marked DLLs, so the window failed to open
(Failed to resolve Python.Runtime.Loader.Initialize). Self-install now strips
the mark, and new Windows users get Kairos-setup.exe (Inno Setup, per-user,
no admin), whose installed files never carry it and which unpacks faster.
